basis: Myofibrillar muscle disease; persistent swallowing dysfunction in 7/9 and eyelid ptosis in 3/9. Restrictive ventilation is only 2/9; respiratory infections are secondary.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: persistent dysphagia in 7/9 (~78%) represents loss of swallowing function from the myopathy.
decisions.ocular: involved: myopathic ptosis in 3/9 (~33%) is persistent eyelid dysfunction; eyelids belong to the ocular axis.

basis: Site-variable umbrella, predominantly mediastinal or retroperitoneal, without a shared listed organ axis. CNS and lung origins define particular subtypes.

decisions.pulmonary: none: mediastinum is not lung; pulmonary origin is a site-specific subtype, not a usual feature across this umbrella.
decisions.neurologic: none: CNS origin defines a subtype and cannot be generalized to most extragonadal germ cell tumours.

basis: DNAJC21-related marrow failure and immunodeficiency; skeletal abnormalities reported in roughly half of cases. Pancreatic insufficiency is not a consistent defining feature of this subtype.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: pancreatic insufficiency in classic Shwachman-Diamond syndrome cannot be generalized to DNAJC21 disease; >=30% is not established.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: congenital skeletal abnormalities occur in roughly half of reported DNAJC21 cases; estimates come from small series.

basis: Short-rib thoracic skeletal dysplasia; pulmonary hypoplasia and lasting respiratory impairment commonly exceed 30%. Renal, hepatic and retinal damage are not established at >=30% for this subtype.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pulmonary hypoplasia and respiratory impairment affect >30%; they result from the defining restrictive thoracic skeletal dysplasia.

basis: The definition explicitly locates the causal pathology in the hypothalamus, with excessive pituitary stimulation and thyroid hormone production.

decisions.neurologic: primary: hypothalamic brain pathology is an explicit defining location; additional neurological symptoms are not required for a primary label.

basis: Poorly characterized hereditary serotonin-metabolism regulatory entry; metabolic assignment is provisional. No supplied clinical phenotype supports a neurological or other organ label.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: provisional mapping of a hereditary serotonin-metabolism regulatory concept; the record supplies no defined clinical syndrome.

basis: Axonal sensorimotor neuropathy; chronic distal muscle atrophy and fixed foot deformity affect >30% over the course, representing tissue loss and structural impairment beyond weakness alone.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: characteristic chronic distal amyotrophy and fixed pes cavus affect >30%; these are lasting structural consequences integral to CMT.

basis: Cerebellar malformation defines disease. Eye and vision abnormalities are 5-29%; the 30-79% septo-optic dysplasia annotation describes a distinct associated disorder, not proven ocular damage.

decisions.ocular: none: explicit eye/vision abnormalities are 5-29%; associated septo-optic dysplasia is separately diagnosable and does not establish ocular loss at >=30%.

basis: Skeletal dysplasia; dental eruption and occlusion defects 80-99%; developmental impairment/seizures 30-79%. Microtia and microcornea lack documented functional impairment.

decisions.otologic: none: microtia is reported in 80-99%, but external-ear shape and size alone do not establish hearing loss or other functional ear damage.

basis: Neurodevelopmental syndrome; persistent swallowing and intestinal motility dysfunction occur in 30-79%. Developmental incontinence and joint laxity do not establish additional organ damage.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: chronic dysphagia and intestinal dysmotility are persistent losses of gastrointestinal function reported in 30-79%; reflux alone is not the basis.
